The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 26deb84be9ead684), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After an axial symmetry, any nonzero lattice displacement may be written (k, j) with k ≥ 1 and |j| ≤ k. Its height variance is Ec h(k, j) − h(0, 0) 2 = 2 Re Z 1 − f(1)k f(±i)|j| dµ(f) = 4κ log k + O(1), (4.34) where the sign of i is chosen according to the vertical direction. The error is uniform over these displacements. In particular the variance is bounded by C(1 + log(1 + |k| + |j|)).
